functions.description: records a combatant defeat into battle log
functions.lever: declare entry pointer before killer lookup (fixed r5/r6 swap); plain unsigned char rank/style source fields
functions.notes: Size, shape and control flow match. Remaining 180 bytes: (1) at +0x1d4 the ROM schedules ldr status between cmp and bicne for the guarded-flags clear before stm; (2) every bitfield copy entry->colors.x = stats->colors.x (u16 at entry+0x18/0x1a from stats+0x22) and the nibble copies at entry+0x1c/0x1d colour as ptr r1, dst word r0, src r2 in the ROM vs ptr r0, dst r1, src r0 in ours. Tried with no gain: colorsweep (its only proposal swaps struct members, bogus), u32 bitfield containers for src or dst, signed dst bitfields, array/struct pairs, inline getter, typed temps, explicit mask form, indexed entries[n] form, ternary/struct-copy for flags. A u32 src container (vA) gave the ROM's ptr r1/dst r0 colouring but adds a u16 truncation.
